title: Eastern roots: the first champions
summary: Eastern Championship Wrestling begins with recognizable veterans and a new local roster. The early championship succession introduces the Sandman before his familiar extreme persona develops.

chapters.title: Snuka becomes the first champion
chapters.result: Snuka defeats Bellomo to become the inaugural ECW Heavyweight champion.
chapters.context: This regional title predates the world-title designation adopted in 1994.

chapters.title: Sandman wins his first championship
chapters.result: Sandman defeats Muraco for the ECW Heavyweight title.
chapters.context: The future hardcore figure is still in the earlier phase of his character.
